extra.final_summary:
Total body mass (g) by species across all 66 penguins: Gentoo 115,200 g, Chinstrap 81,475 g, Adelie 80,400 g.

Data quality checks and fixes:
- body_mass_g was stored as text with two comma-formatted values ("4,925" in row 42, "3,400" in row 52). Cast the column to numeric (no values lost); all values fall within the rules-file range of 2500–6500 g.
- species labels are clean and match the allowed labels (Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo), so no normalization was needed.
- No duplicate rows.

Issues noticed but not fixed (they don't affect this question): flipper_length_mm has 3 negative values (e.g. -208, -203) that violate the 170–235 mm range, and the sex column has a "female " variant with a trailing space. These columns weren't used in the analysis.
